sloka: पुरा नाम्ना हि दुर्वासा अत्रेः पुत्रो महामुनिः ।वसिष्ठस्याश्रमे पुण्ये वार्षिक्यं समुवास ह ।। ७.५१.२ ॥
transliteration: purā nāmnā hi durvāsā atreḥ putro mahāmuniḥ ।vasiṣṭhasyāśrame puṇye vārṣikyaṁ samuvāsa ha ।। 7.51.2 ॥

translations.english: Formerly, a great sage named Durvasa, the son of Atri, resided in the sacred hermitage of Vasishtha during the rainy season.
